legend.light blue diamond: Gem or gem/nab-p; 1 = First-line therapy, 2 = Second-line therapy, 5 = Fifth-line therapy

cells.value: Patient response to next therapy line

output.notes: In-vitro prediction scores: high responder = 1, intermediate responder = 2, low responder = 3. Prediction score ≤2 indicates response; >2 indicates no response. Merged YES/NO boxes are repeated across each patient column they span.
